title: New Contextualism
description: An architectural and urban design philosophy exploring the relationships between people, place, history, culture, ecology, and the built environment.
prepublicationNote: Texts are drawn from published sources and from editorial drafts awaiting the founder’s approval.

mission.text: To develop and share New Contextualism as an open, rigorous and critically examined approach to architecture and urbanism: documenting its sources, testing its methods in teaching and practice, and inviting dialogue across disciplines and regions.

vision.text: Built environments that are rooted in their places, just to the people who inhabit them, and prepared for the futures they will meet.
